verdict.rationale: Tavily's SDK explicitly exposes a one-call Q&A endpoint (qna_search) described as returning accurate, concise answers 'in one line of code, perfect for usage by LLMs,' and the base search call returns an LLM-ready answer plus sourced results usable in RAG pipelines (get_search_context). Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the answer response includes inline citation URLs alongside the generated answer, and independent (non-vendor) confirmation of answer quality.
